title: Semi-explicit entropic solution to a generalised Riemann problem in some hydrological context
summary: We discuss solutions of the one dimensional scalar conservation law with the flux function $y\longmapsto G_{c,ρ}\left(y\right)=((1-ρ)c-y)\mathbb{1}_{\{y>c\}}-ρy\mathbb{1}_{\{y\leqslant c\}}$ for two specific initial conditions $u(\cdot,0)=u_0$. This equation arises as the limit of a specific conceptual hydrological model. For initial data strictly below (resp. above) the threshold level $c$, the equation reduces to a constant-speed transport equation with velocity $p$ (resp. $1$).
